title: Finite-Precision Quantum Mechanics: Quantum Parcels, Information and Geometry
summary: Quantum mechanics represents states by exactly specified density operators, whereas experimentally available information is necessarily finite in precision. We develop \emph{Interval Quantum Mechanics (IQM)}, in which finite observational information is represented by a \emph{quantum parcel}, a convex open set of density operators. Experimental parcels are determined by finitely many expectation intervals and form a basis for the state-space topology.
